negative.label: Polite negative
negative.definition: Present short 안 negation or long -지 않아요. Include idiomatic variants where appropriate.

future.label: Polite future
future.definition: Informal polite -(으)ㄹ 거예요, including predictions for adjectives

ongoing.label: Polite ongoing
ongoing.definition: Informal polite -고 있어요 for actions. Null for entries where this exercise does not teach an ongoing form.

desire.label: Want to
desire.definition: Verb stem + -고 싶어요 to express wanting to do an action. Null for adjectives.

negativeDesire.label: Don’t want to
negativeDesire.definition: Verb stem + -고 싶지 않아요 to express not wanting to do an action. Null for adjectives.

explanations.present: 가 takes -아요, and 가아요 contracts to 가요.
explanations.past: 가 takes -았어요, and 가았어요 contracts to 갔어요.

explanations.present: The stem vowel is ㅓ, so add -어요 to 먹.
explanations.past: The stem vowel is ㅓ, so add -었어요 to 먹.

explanations.present: Change the final ㄷ to ㄹ before -어요: 듣 → 들 → 들어요.
explanations.past: Change the final ㄷ to ㄹ before -었어요: 듣 → 들 → 들었어요.
explanations.future: Change ㄷ to ㄹ before the future ending: 듣 → 들 → 들을 거예요.

explanations.present: Change the final ㄷ to ㄹ before -어요: 걷 → 걸 → 걸어요.
explanations.past: Change the final ㄷ to ㄹ before -었어요: 걷 → 걸 → 걸었어요.
explanations.future: Change ㄷ to ㄹ before the future ending: 걷 → 걸 → 걸을 거예요.

explanations.present: Replace the final ㅂ with 오, then combine 도오 + -아요 to get 도와요.
explanations.past: Replace the final ㅂ with 오, then combine 도오 + -았어요 to get 도왔어요.
explanations.future: Replace the final ㅂ with 우, then add -ㄹ 거예요: 도우 → 도울 거예요.

explanations.present: Drop ㅡ and add -어요 to get 써요.
explanations.past: Drop ㅡ and add -었어요 to get 썼어요.

explanations.present: Change 하다 to 해요: 공부하다 → 공부해요.
explanations.past: Change 하다 to 했어요: 공부하다 → 공부했어요.
explanations.negative: Add -지 않아요 to 공부하 for 공부하지 않아요. For short negation, put 안 before 해요: 공부 안 해요.

explanations.present: The last stem vowel is ㅡ, so add -어요 to 만들.
explanations.past: The last stem vowel is ㅡ, so add -었어요 to 만들.

explanations.present: Before -어요, drop ㅡ from 르 and add ㄹ to the preceding syllable: 부르 → 불러요.
explanations.past: Before -었어요, drop ㅡ from 르 and add ㄹ to the preceding syllable: 부르 → 불렀어요.

explanations.present: Drop the final ㅅ before -어요: 짓 → 지 → 지어요.
explanations.past: Drop the final ㅅ before -었어요: 짓 → 지 → 지었어요.
explanations.future: Drop the final ㅅ and use -을 거예요: 짓 → 지 → 지을 거예요.

explanations.present: Add -아요 to 보 to get 보아요. ㅗ + ㅏ can contract to ㅘ, giving 봐요.
explanations.past: Add -았어요 to 보 to get 보았어요. ㅗ + ㅏ can contract to ㅘ, giving 봤어요.

explanations.present: Add -아요 to 오 and combine ㅗ + ㅏ into ㅘ: 와요.
explanations.past: Add -았어요 to 오 and combine ㅗ + ㅏ into ㅘ: 왔어요.

explanations.present: Drop 다 to get 읽. The stem vowel is ㅣ, so add -어요: 읽어요.
explanations.past: Drop 다 to get 읽. The stem vowel is ㅣ, so add -었어요: 읽었어요.

explanations.present: Drop the final ㅡ. The preceding vowel ㅖ calls for -어요: 예뻐요.
explanations.past: Drop the final ㅡ. The preceding vowel ㅖ calls for -었어요: 예뻤어요.

explanations.present: Replace the final ㅂ with 우, then combine 추우 + -어요 to get 추워요.
explanations.past: Replace the final ㅂ with 우, then combine 추우 + -었어요 to get 추웠어요.
explanations.future: Replace the final ㅂ with 우, then add -ㄹ 거예요: 추우 → 추울 거예요.

explanations.present: Drop ㅡ and add -어요 to get 커요.
explanations.past: Drop ㅡ and add -었어요 to get 컸어요.

explanations.present: Keep ㅎ and add -아요 after the stem vowel ㅗ: 좋 → 좋아요.
explanations.past: Keep ㅎ and add -았어요 after the stem vowel ㅗ: 좋 → 좋았어요.

explanations.present: The stem vowel is ㅣ, so add -어요 to 길.
explanations.past: The stem vowel is ㅣ, so add -었어요 to 길.

explanations.present: Before -아요, drop ㅡ from 르 and add ㄹ to the preceding syllable: 빠르 → 빨라요.
explanations.past: Before -았어요, drop ㅡ from 르 and add ㄹ to the preceding syllable: 빠르 → 빨랐어요.

explanations.present: Drop the final ㅎ and combine ㅑ with the present ending to get ㅒ: 하얘요.
explanations.past: Drop the final ㅎ and combine ㅑ with the past ending to get ㅒ: 하얬어요.
explanations.future: Drop the final ㅎ and add -ㄹ 거예요: 하야 → 하얄 거예요.

explanations.present: The last stem vowel is ㅣ, so add -어요 to 재미있.
explanations.past: The last stem vowel is ㅣ, so add -었어요 to 재미있.
explanations.negative: Add -지 않아요 to 재미있 for 재미있지 않아요. You can also replace 있다 with 없다: 재미없어요 or 재미가 없어요.
